purpose: Coordinate bounded implementation and independent review of work items.

trigger: Implement this decomposed plan with specialist agents
Run separate builder and reviewer passes for each task
Parallelize independent code tasks with final integration
do_not_trigger: Answer a single factual question from memory
Deploy an unreviewed change to production

preflight: Confirm a bounded plan with dependency ordering and no overlapping write ownership.
Assign unique worktrees, role scopes, retry and token budgets.
Choose durable Kanban for work that must survive the current process.
workflow: Dispatch only independent units with exact output contracts.
Inspect completed artifacts rather than trusting agent summaries.
Run independent specification then code-quality review.
Integrate only verified changes and preserve a recoverable checkpoint.

evidence.how_to_verify: Dependency graph with ownership, budgets and acceptance tests.
Confirm each accepted patch in final integrated head.
Record reviewer signoff or explicit findings and rework status.

failure_modes: If a child disappears, use durable task state; do not infer success from silence.
Do not retry an unknown external side effect or spawn unbounded replacements.
